me:2003:q38.title: GATE ME 2003 | Set 1 | Question: 38
me:2003:q38.question: A bullet of mass "m" travels at a very high velocity v (as shown in the figure) and gets embedded inside the block of mass "M" initially at rest on a rough horizontal floor. detailed_solution.concept: Engineering Mechanics - Impulse and Momentum, Energy Formulations
detailed_solution.markdown:
From conservation of linear momentum

$$\begin{aligned} m V&=(M+m) U\\ \therefore \quad U & =\frac{m V}{M+m} \\ \vec{f}_{k} & =\mu N(-\hat{i}) \\ \vec{f}_{k} & =\mu(M+m) g(-\hat{i}) \\ \vec{a} & =\frac{7_{k}}{(M+m)} \\ \vec{a} & =\mu g(-\hat{i}) \\ \text{Now }\quad V_{2}^{2}&=U^{2}-2 \mu g s \\ \therefore & 0=\left(\frac{m V}{M+m}\right)^{2}-2 \mu g s \\ \therefore & V=\left(\frac{M+m}{m}\right) \sqrt{2 \mu g s} \end{aligned}$$

Therefore, the correct answer is **A**.

me:2003:q39.title: GATE ME 2003 | Set 1 | Question: 39

From differential equation of elastic curve

Therefore, the correct answer is **A**.

since tool life = no. of component produce $\times$ tool constant

Therefore, the correct answer is **A**.
